subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these coordinated action upgrades be accepted after direct Codex-contract verification and exact-head security/workflow checks, or should the Codex action bump be separated for independent review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it replaces executable code in credentialed and security-sensitive workflows, and repository policy assigns those trust-boundary decisions to owners rather than automation alone.

options.title: Verify and land together

options.title: Split the Codex upgrade
options.body: Land the routine official action pins separately and move openai/codex-action 1.11 into a focused PR with explicit permission-profile validation.
